title: Woman Kicks Cop & Faces The Consequences
description:
On August 11th, 2022, an Officer was dispatched in reference to a disturbance on a bus. The female had recently moved to Florida from Illinois, after she was kicked out of her house by her parents. The female claimed that she was a recovering addict while painting a vivid picture of her life. The officer then proceeded to check if the female had any prior warrants against her. While the officer was on the phone, the female randomly jumped from the bench, and punched a Gulf View Square Mall security officer who was trying to enter the building through the entrance next to the bench. The officer detained the female and then proceeded to ask the victim if he wanted to press charges. The officer then decided to confront the female about her assault on the security officer. The officer then transported the female to another patrol vehicle as they waited for medical assistance to arrive. Soon, medics arrived on the scene to transport the female to a hospital. The female continued gibbering nonsense and even compared herself to Jeffery Dahmer, the infamous and racist serial killer. The female was transported to the hospital where she continued to resist when the doctors were trying to help her. The female was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
